title: Choose Kivi's visual world
question: The roll assigned Tailgate (Indian truck art). Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Tailgate
options.lineage: Hand-painted Indian truck art: 'Horn OK Please' tailgates
options.thesis: The home screen is a painted tailgate that tells every caller how to get through.
options.viewport: Kivi on a framed tailgate panel: the state word in shaded sign lettering, painted rules 'FAVOURITES RING THROUGH · CALL TWICE IF URGENT'; standard Material modes grid and call inbox below.
options.risk: Turns into festival kitsch if the paint spreads beyond the tailgate panel; everything else must stay calm Material.

raised.raise: Every call row carries its duration, right-aligned tight to the margin.
One strict type scale: the sign lettering appears at exactly two sizes, never improvised.
Transcript and actions appear only when a note is opened; the inbox stays one line of truth per call.
One motion grammar everywhere: a single duration with a small overshoot, including the panel repaint on mode change.
Transcripts are mirrored columns: caller left, Kivi right, time running down.

options.label: Inland Letter
options.lineage: India Post inland letter cards and rubber-stamp postmarks
options.thesis: Every call becomes a letter left for you; its category is a postmark.
options.viewport: Kivi inside an inland-letter card with an ON DUTY postmark; letters-for-you inbox with stamped categories.
options.risk: The paper-and-stamp metaphor is the familiar destination for message apps; most runs land near it.

options.label: Arrivals Board
options.thesis: Your calls arrive like trains: time, caller, status, one ruled row each.
options.viewport: State word on flaps beside Kivi; an ARRIVALS board of calls with amber/red status columns.
options.case: Fuses cleanly (calls as arrivals, category as status); holds clarity but loses on Indian identification.
options.risk: Reads cold and transit-themed; the elephant's warmth fights the black board.

options.label: Cassette J-card
options.case: Loses both axes: no link to screening or Indian callers.
options.kept: Durations right-aligned tight to the margin.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.case: Loses both axes: cold, unreadable in Indic scripts.

options.label: Title Wall
options.case: Loses both axes: calls have no artwork.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.thesis: Modes as lobes of a map.
options.case: Loses both axes: playful but hides the inbox.
options.kept: One motion grammar with a small overshoot.

options.label: Dance Score
options.kept: Mirrored columns: caller left, Kivi right.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Material 3 dark with Dynamic Color, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Status card, mode chips, call list: what Google's Call Screen users expect.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other call app by design.
